name: dataforseo-mcp-server

tools.name: docs_index
tools.description: Fetch the DataForSEO API documentation index (llms.txt), optionally filtered by section

tools.name: docs_list_sections
tools.description: Return available DataForSEO API documentation section names

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Fetch DataForSEO API documentation from a documentation URL

url.description: Documentation URL or path (e.g. https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/serp/google/organic/live/regular or serp/google/organic/live/regular)

needCodeExample.description: Include multi-language code examples (PHP, Node.js, Python, C#)

tools.name: api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated request to the DataForSEO API

data.description: Request body as JSON object or array of task objects

noAiMode.description: Disable the .ai path suffix and return the full response schema instead of the AI-optimized subset. Can increase context size significantly. Default: false.

instructions:
DataForSEO API tools: browse documentation (docs_index, docs_list_sections, docs_search) and make authenticated API requests (api_request). 
   Prefer OAuth Bearer tokens via HTTP transport (authorization server https://data.dataforseo.com). 
   DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD remain an optional env fallback. 
   Documentation cache directory can be set at server startup with --docs-cache-dir <path> (24h TTL).
